summary: xAI released Grok 4.6, an update to Grok 4.5 with improved agentic coding, long-running task performance, and visual/interactive project generation, available via API, Cursor, Grok Build and other partners at stated pricing.

mechanisms.reason: The model underwent a longer supplemental training run than its predecessor, implying additional training compute was used.
mechanisms.quote: Grok 4.6 underwent a longer supplemental training run than Grok 4.5, with curated model-generated data for reasoning and advanced technical concepts, high-quality engineering data, and an improved optimizer and training recipe.

practices.reason: The model shows stated gains in sustaining long multi-step agentic tasks, agentic coding benchmarks, and first-pass visual/interactive application generation, relevant for teams building agent or coding tools.
practices.quote: Grok 4.6 builds on Grok 4.5 with a particular focus on long-running agents and more ambitious interactive and visual work.
